# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old by the end of Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c29 P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c5 P7](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, black eyes, and long, glossy black hair worn in curls. She inherits her merry expression from her father. As she grows into womanhood, she develops a plump, dimpled figure, although she occasionally worries about gaining weight.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v3 c33 P25](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0025)_

## Personality

Diana is a good-natured, amiable, and practical girl with a cheerful laugh. She is deeply loyal, warm-hearted, and affectionate toward her close friends. While she does not possess a wild or vivid imagination like Anne's, she is a sympathetic listener and loves reading excited or romantic stories. She is also sensible, well-mannered, and devoted to her family.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c26 P18](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0018), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009)_

## Goals

- To build a happy home and family with Fred Wright  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v2 c29 P29](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0029), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)</sub>
- To remain lifelong bosom friends with Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope near Green Gables. Shortly after Anne Shirley arrived in Avonlea, the two girls met in the Barry garden and swore an oath of eternal friendship to be bosom friends. Their early companionship involved playing in Mr. Bell's birch grove, creating playhouses, and reading exciting books together. A temporary rift occurred when Diana unwittingly drank three glasses of currant wine at Green Gables thinking it was raspberry cordial; Mrs. Barry forbade the girls to play together until Diana's little sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup, and Anne saved the child's life. Following this, Mrs. Barry lifted the ban and the girls reunited. Later, Diana accidentally jumped on her wealthy, strict Great-Aunt Josephine during a sleepover, which temporarily enraged the old lady until Anne intervened. Diana attended Avonlea school with Anne, participated in the A.V.I.S. (Avonlea Village Improvement Society), and enjoyed social gatherings together, though she did not pursue higher education at Queen's or Redmond College. Instead, she became engaged to Fred Wright, a young Avonlea farmer, and married him in her eighteenth year in the orchard at Orchard Slope.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v3 c29 P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. George Barry  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Had no sisters of her own age, only a much younger sister named Minnie May  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and other local children  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Anne Shirley, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

> I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> I’m so happy, but it does seem ridiculous to think of me being engaged.  <sub>[v2 c29 P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)</sub>

> We are not really parting, Anne. I’m not going far away. We’ll love each other just as much as ever.  <sub>[v3 c29 P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003)</sub>
